# MathOs

> A completely free hybrid summer applied math camp — attend in person or online for students roughly at the 4th–7th grade math level. Live on Zoom, Tuesdays and Thursdays, 3–5 PM Central, July 7–30, 2026.

MathOs is a free, hybrid summer math camp run by student Camp Directors — campers can attend in person or join live over Zoom. Our pilot year ran fully online to gauge the community's reaction, and because it was such a hit we shifted to a hybrid format so out-of-state campers can still join. Sessions are taught with a focus on hands-on, applied math — problem solving, games, geometry, and project work — culminating in a final showcase.
